notes.title: Optimization, Fixes & New Features
notes.notes:
[p]In this patch, we’ve made the game run a bit smoother and tackled some annoying issues that were affecting the experience. The helicopter sound spamming and Escape button problems are now fixed. We’ve also added a [b]Main Menu[/b] and a [b]Restart shortcut[/b] on Victory and Defeat screens, making it quicker and easier to jump back into the action.[/p][p]Thanks for all your support and feedback — every update makes the game better! 🚀

[b]Endless Mode is coming soon. with some new features.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Rage of Towers is Now Fully Released
notes.notes: [p]Dear Defenders,[/p][p]After months of development, testing, and your amazing feedback, we’re excited to announce that [b]Rage of Towers is officially out of Early Access and fully released![/b] 🏰🔥[/p][p]This full release includes:[/p][list][*][p]✅ \[Highlight a few big features — e.g., new maps, towers, enemies, or game modes][/p][/*][*][p]✅ \[Improvements/optimizations made during EA][/p][/*][*][p]✅ \[Any new content or polish added for launch][/p][/*][/list][p]We couldn’t have done this without the support of our community — thank you for playing, sharing feedback, and helping shape the game into what it is today. 🙌[/p][p]But this isn’t the end! We’ll continue to improve the game and have plans for \[optional: future updates / expansions / quality-of-life features].[/p]

notes.title: All Bugs Squashed – The Game Just Got Smoother!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]Big news — we’ve gone through the game with a fine-tooth comb and fixed every bug and glitch we’ve discovered so far. You should notice smoother gameplay and a more polished experience from here on out.[/p][p]We’re truly sorry it took us a bit longer to get these fixes out, and we deeply appreciate your patience while we worked on them. Your support and feedback have been amazing, and it keeps us motivated to keep improving the game.[/p][p]Now’s the perfect time to jump back in and see the improvements for yourself. And as always — keep sharing your feedback, it helps us make the game even better.[/p][p]Thank you for being part of this journey with us! 🙏[/p][p][/p][p]TAS[/p]

notes.title: Rage of Towers – Full Launch is Here!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’re incredibly excited to announce that [b]Rage Of Towers [/b]is leaving [b]Early Access[/b] and will be officially [b]launching on Steam in just a few days![/b] 🥳[/p][p]This has been an amazing journey, and we couldn't have reached this point without [b]your feedback, support, and encouragement[/b] throughout Early Access. You've helped shape the game into what it is today, and we're truly grateful.[/p][p]💬 [b]What Happens to Early Access Players?[/b]
If you've already purchased the game in Early Access – [b]thank you![/b] You’ll automatically receive the full version when it launches.[/p][p]💡 [b]What's Next?[/b]
While this marks the "official" release, we're not stopping here. We’ll continue to listen to your feedback and explore future updates, fixes, and possible new content.[/p][p]Stay tuned for the full release , and help us spread the word![/p][p]With gratitude,[/p][p]TAS Studio[/p]
